name: NBOMe-mescaline
summary: NBOMe-mescaline, also known as mescaline-NBOMe, M-NBOMe, or N-(2-methoxybenzyl)-3,4,5-trimethoxyphenethylamine, is a serotonin receptor agonist and putative psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, scaline, and N-benzylphenethylamine (NBOMe) families. It is the N-(2-methoxybenzyl) derivative of mescaline.

pharmacology.text: NBOMe-mescaline is a partial agonist of serotonin receptors, with a 5-HT2A pKi originally reported as 7.3 (i.e. Ki of approximately 50 nM), though more modern techniques assayed it as 140 nM at 5-HT2A and 640 nM at 5-HT2C, making it one of the least potent compounds among the N-benzylphenethylamines. Nonetheless, it is 68-fold more potent than mescaline as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist in vitro.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It is a research compound and has been described in the scientific literature. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，已在科學文獻中被描述，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，已在科学文献中被描述，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related N-benzyl drugs, the NBOMes, have caused seizures, a dangerously fast heart rate, very high body temperature and deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。相關的 N-苄基類藥物 NBOMe 曾造成癲癇發作、危險的心跳過快、極高體溫以及死亡案例。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。相关的 N-苄基类药物 NBOMe 曾造成癫痫发作、危险的心跳过快、极高体温以及死亡案例。

fact.en: Adding an N-benzyl group to a phenethylamine psychedelic usually makes it far more potent, as it does for the 2C drugs, but with mescaline the same change gives only a modest increase.
fact.zh: 在苯乙胺類迷幻藥上加入 N-苄基通常會讓藥效大幅增強，2C 系列就是如此，但在麥司卡林上做同樣的改動，藥效只略微提升。
fact.zhHans: 在苯乙胺类迷幻药上加入 N-苄基通常会让药效大幅增强，2C 系列就是如此，但在麦司卡林上做同样的改动，药效只略微提升。
